standard_prerequisites.name: The image of an irreducible space is irreducible, and dominance puts the generic point in the image
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Topology, labels topology-lemma-image-irreducible-space and topology-lemma-irreducible (proof lines 1828-1830); Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-dominant-finite-number-irreducible-components (proof line 1834)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first shows the closure of the image is irreducible, and the second lets the generic point of the target be taken in the image when the morphism is dominant.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness of a field extension of transcendence degree zero, under the permanence of finite type
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, labels morphisms-lemma-finite-degree (proof line 1841) and morphisms-lemma-permanence-finite-type (proof line 1843)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the equality of the dimension function values at the two generic points into the statement that the extension of function fields has transcendence degree zero, hence is finite.

core_obligations: Split on the closure of the image: the closure of the image is irreducible, so if it is not the whole target we are done (proof lines 1826-1831).

In the dominant case identify generic points: dominance puts the generic point of the target in the image, so the generic point of the source maps to it and the two dimension function values agree (proof lines 1832-1839).
Conclude finiteness: the resulting extension of function fields has transcendence degree zero, hence is finite by the finite degree criterion (proof lines 1840-1843).
proof_roadmap: Closure of the image and the non dominant case (proof lines 1826-1831).
Dominant case and identification of generic points (proof lines 1832-1839).
Finiteness of the function field extension (proof lines 1840-1843).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism between integral schemes of equal relative dimension is either not dominant or dominant with finite extension of function fields (statement lines 1815-1824, tag 02QF-adjacent). The proof splits on whether the closure of the image is the whole target, uses dominance to identify the images of the generic points, and converts the equality of the dimension function values into the statement that the extension of function fields has transcendence degree zero, hence is finite. The identification of the generic points is the substance, so the claim is H2.
